title: Battle of Fisher's Hill
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Fisher's Hill", at revision 1381308652, opens: "The Battle of Fisher's Hill was fought September 21–22, 1864, near Strasburg, Virginia, as part of the Valley Campaigns of 1864 during the American Civil War. Despite its strong defensive position, the Confederate army of Lt. Gen. Jubal Early was defeated by the Union Army of the Shenandoah, commanded by Maj. Gen. Philip Sheridan." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q766944, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1864 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
